name: ZAPTEST
description_en:
ZAPTEST is a product in the Software testing category. Its directory profile covers Live Web Testing, Bug Tracking, Continuous Integration, Seamless Integration, Test Recorder, Cross Device Testing, Reporting and Analysis, Parallel Testing.

Additional listed capabilities include Scheduling, Cross Browser Support, Parameterized Testing, Debugging, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep).

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record software defects and follow their progress; allocate times for appointments, resources or tasks; work with supported browsers in a common workflow; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
ZAPTEST 属于软件测试软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括在线网站测试、缺陷跟踪、持续集成、集成能力、测试录制工具、跨设备测试、报表与分析、并行测试。

资料还列出排程管理、跨浏览器支持、参数化测试、代码调试、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：记录软件缺陷并跟踪处理进展；为预约、资源或任务安排时间；在同一流程中使用受支持的不同浏览器；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: The official zaptest.com homepage explicitly redirects to zaptest.ai, now a Human-AI orchestration/ZADS corporate presentation. The old-domain pricing page was actually read and describes three/six-month POC programs embedded in a twelve-month paid subscription, explicitly not a free trial. Official /docs/ returned403; no retry or bypass. The current deep technical/fee/identity chain cannot be completed from marketing and cross-domain presentation alone. No old Free-edition claim, unlimited capability or current live test result is adopted.
research_gaps.zh: 官方 zaptest.com 首页明确跳转 zaptest.ai，目前是 Human-AI 编排／ZADS 企业介绍。已读旧域价格页，描述三／六个月 POC 嵌入十二个月付费订阅，并明确并非免费试用。官方 /docs/ 返回 403，未重试或绕过。仅营销及跨域介绍无法完成当前深度技术／费用／身份链，未采用旧 Free 版本主张、无限能力或当前实测结果。
